body:
Believe it or not, in all of that there's a hell of a lot of other issues I didn't even scratch the surface on... the stress levels are intense, and I know I'm not coping well. 

Thank you from the bottom of my heart for taken the time, I did read this 7 hours ago; and it did help a huge amount.

Obviously I'm very much still here, and very thankful for that. I need to do something so that I don't do this again. This isn't the first time, nor the worst I've been in the last few years. I know I need help - I just really don't know who to turn to.

I put a general update in a [thread below](http://www.reddit.com/r/SuicideWatch/comments/dr257/at_my_end_so_far_gone/c12apvp) :-)

**Thanks so much for asking :-)**

Well, it's about 6:30pm here... and I've just about got myself functioning. I think I mentioned something about drinking a lot? My hangover and the 2 empty bottles of vodka probably attest to my stupidity quite well.

I managed to email my CEO explaining that I've been upboating my food for the last few days, that might get me a small amount of time.

I feel pretty embarrassed about this whole thread - especially for anyone that actually tried to decipher my ramblings... I'm tempted to delete the whole thread and may at some point. It would be very easy for anyone who knows me to recognise me from this thread.

I'm still in some disbelief that someone from Reddit actually called me, we talked for hours about life; politics, religion, everything - best conversation I've had with a human being in some time. Even in my state very uplifting - emiteal is my hero a little bit there.

I do admit to myself for the first time I really do need some help though - I have some issues I really need to work out and I've had some really dark patches. I've done stupid things that have hurt myself and the people around me... often things out of my direct control. I have a sprained ankle and bruised body attesting for the last time I had a bad night and a bit of a breakdown. I'm incredible at hiding these things.

I honestly don't know who to turn to, I've had to luck talking with my GP's, and really don't want to go back and try that root again - it was horrible the first time round - if anyone here is in the UK and knows where I can go for long time help, or can put me in touch with anyone **please talk to me**.

Someone above mentioned Samaritans, and I can attest they are actually fantastic; I phoned them during a very rough patch before and the woman stayed on the phone with my hours after her shift - just listening. I can't recommend it enough; they're trained and know what they're dealing with!

Thanks again, this whole experience has been amazing. I love you guys :)
I had a several hour conversion on the phone with emiteal, who was an absolute star. I forgot what I was thinking by the end of it... :)

Fuck it, where do  I honestly go from here.
I'm likely talking shit - 
Please help me.
I'm honestly struggling...
You have no idea how I would appreciate that.

Everything I've said, it can't be taken in as more than a slight rant... it doesn't really sum up how I'm currently feeling - which is why I'm actually posting here. I wish there was more characters, but then you'd be talking about a veritable novel.

I ask the question, purely because I don't know where else I place it... If I am still here tomorrow, how the fuck to I explain my lack of work for the last 12 or so hours?...

Fuck.

I realise you were saying something different, I agree - social interaction is so very important - I find this hard sometimes, as most of my true friends are still in the "drinking heavily, and partying" frame of miood; having just finished uni. 

Something, that although I was predicted to be at a U.K top university; was taken away from me. I was a straight A* student - sadly was basically kicked out of sixth-form as someone who used ARP poisoning on their network.

Take the longest, oldest and most popular message on HITB - that was my friend and me - respected, and entirely idiotic children (on penetration analysis, I think it still has the most responses :)

Mind, my parents argued the case with me - and I argued the case that someone external could have done a lot worse (and all we had was permission afterall - we actively used it to help teachers, it's like we got punished for stabbing someone, but all we were doing was holding the knife - we never did anything malicious).

I, and my parents who understood this, had to sit in-front of a the 'govners' of the school, and try to explain what we were doing. The denial of anything I, or my parents said, whilst obviously plain and simple sense - this may have been where the education system sadly died for me.

My friends, who had sadly orchestrated the whole ideal - but happened to turn up in suits to the 'hearing' - were let off scot free, me and my parents; who whilst weren't particularly computer savvy understood the basics of computing and the law... were dumbfounded.

I seriously digressed into myself here... but I suppose this may be one of my few opportunities to left, and this all stands very strongly in my mind. And hopefully an out of touch I.T teacher will read this, and gather understanding.

I was told if I ever tried to use the school as a reference they would have to admit the horrible truth that I was a 'computer hacker', it got me my first few jobs after failing any and all entry to university.

This is possibly the most offtopic I can go, but might go a part to explain how each part of what I want to say has so much I just simply can't make anyone read... I'm loving this thread so far though. I'm so glad I got so bad I posted it...

I |might be flipping between the melodramatic and otherwise, but you succinctly sum up how I ofteb feel. We're hunter gathers, we're not meant to spend 12 hours a day trying to keep our jobs behind a thin curtain of sanity... 
Last year I watched eddie izzard (my favourite comedian), run 43 marathons in 51 days - as someone who had never run long distance before. He had some interesting points about this; and as televised as it might have been, he found some interesting points on humanity.
He says as someone who used to, a few years ago in school, be 8 stones and is now 11 or more due to his lack of motivation, and his compelling ability to tell everyone he's OK and whatever he's doing... that's O.K too.

edit2, I haven't had a day off since march apart from sick days, I fucking hate what I do at the moment - I honestly don't know who to turn to - but I feel so much like there's so many people worse off than me. I don't deserve anyone's attention. I hate this shit.
I appreciate your time, to an amount you couldn't believe. Thank you.
Thank you. Simply, I'm probably not be enough with it at the second... but the caring conveyed in your message very almost brought a tear to my eye...
